name: contract_m4_wire_and_seams
description: The M4 contract (docs/design/contract-m4.md) holds: protocol.json appends M4's numbers (checkpoints every 1,800 ticks, two kept, at most 64 parts, a 5 s upload wait; the catch-up's 2 KB per 50 ms under 4 KB of output; one resync a seat; reconnects every 2 s), its flags and states (MATCH_CONFIG's rejoin, VISIBILITY's shown, hidden and catching_up, LINKS' catching_up, RESYNC's reasons), NOTICE no_held_seat and MATCH_END's desynced_twice, and the new fields (HELLO's held match and seat, MATCH_CONFIG's flags, RESYNC's reason, open turn, checkpoint hash and parts), with every M1-M3 id where it was; the GDScript codec round-trips them; SimTypes names the five seat states and the checkpoint interval; a checkpoint tick, a checkpoint's digest (the state hash, and protocol.py's digest for the same bytes) and its parts follow the contract; a dump goes to user://desync/<match>-<seat>.bin; and the seams (Checkpointing, DesyncDump, WebBridge, ConnectionOverlay) have the contract's methods and do nothing on desktop.

steps.msg: the build keeps the M4 contract
